# Decision

* [ADR-0001 React and TypeScript single-page app](adr-0001-react-typescript-spa.md) - The web UI is a React and TypeScript single-page app built with Vite, with API types generated from the contracts.
* [ADR-0002 Spring Boot REST API](adr-0002-spring-boot-rest-api.md) - The HTTP API is a Java 21 Spring Boot application, pinned to the Spring Boot 4.1.2 release in api/pom.xml.
* [ADR-0003 SQLite persistence](adr-0003-sqlite-persistence.md) - All accounts, sessions and to-dos are stored in one embedded SQLite file whose path comes from TODO_DB_PATH.
* [ADR-0004 Server-side session in an HTTP-only cookie](adr-0004-server-side-session-cookie.md) - Login creates a server-side session row and an HttpOnly cookie, and the API answers 401 both to visitors who never signed in and to those whose session ended.
* [ADR-0005 Argon2id password hashing](adr-0005-argon2id-password-hashing.md) - Passwords are stored only as salted Argon2id hashes, computed over the whole password, with no pre-hash and no 72-byte limit.
* [ADR-0006 Last write wins with whole-content replace](adr-0006-last-write-wins-whole-content-replace.md) - To-do edits have no version check; a content update replaces every content field, and the done toggle is a separate operation that sets only done.
* [ADR-0007 X-Todo-Client header as cross-site request defence](adr-0007-client-header-cross-site-request-defence.md) - Unsafe API methods must carry an X-Todo-Client header, which a cross-site form cannot send, and ClientHeaderFilter refuses the request with 403 otherwise.
* [ADR-0008 Absolute 8-hour session lifetime](adr-0008-absolute-session-lifetime.md) - A session lasts 8 hours from login, is not extended by activity, and ends with no warning, which the requester accepted under WCAG 2.2.1's essential exception.
* [ADR-0009 Spring JDBC without JPA](adr-0009-spring-jdbc-without-jpa.md) - Data access uses hand-written SQL through Spring JdbcClient with no JPA and package-private JDBC repositories, and every to-do statement is filtered by the owner's user id.
* [ADR-0010 Explicit validator classes](adr-0010-explicit-validator-classes.md) - Input rules live in plain validator classes (for example TodoValidator and IdentifierRules) on the server, with mirrored rules in the SPA, rather than in framework annotations.
* [ADR-0011 Problem Details error model](adr-0011-problem-details-error-model.md) - Every API error is an RFC 9457 application/problem+json body with a closed code enum, written by one component, so no stack trace or SQL reaches a client.
* [ADR-0012 Contract tests with the OpenAPI request validator](adr-0012-contract-tests-swagger-request-validator.md) - Every integration request and response is checked against the frozen OpenAPI files with the Atlassian openapi-request-validator v3 line, while cookie security is tested at the application level.
* [ADR-0013 Injected clock and a test-only clock for end-to-end expiry](adr-0013-injected-clock-and-e2e-test-clock.md) - All time comes from an injected Clock, and only a separate e2e profile in the test source set can move it, so the 8-hour expiry can be tested without changing the normal run.
* [ADR-0014 Flyway migrations](adr-0014-flyway-migrations.md) - The schema is created by Flyway at start-up from one versioned migration, V1__init.sql, which is the only place the tables are defined.
* [ADR-0015 Derived lower-case columns for case-insensitive matching](adr-0015-derived-lowercase-columns.md) - Lower-cased copies of identifiers, titles and descriptions are stored beside the originals, so uniqueness and search are case-insensitive with a plain literal substring test.
* [ADR-0016 Single connection pool](adr-0016-single-connection-pool.md) - The application holds one SQLite connection in one Hikari pool, created only by the composition root, which serialises requests for a single local user.
* [ADR-0017 Timestamps as UTC text](adr-0017-timestamps-as-utc-text.md) - Timestamps are stored as fixed-format UTC text with millisecond precision, so text order equals time order, and due dates are stored as date-only text with no time zone.
* [ADR-0018 Modular monolith with module boundaries](adr-0018-modular-monolith-module-boundaries.md) - The API is one deployable split into an identity module, a to-dos module, a shared kernel and a composition root, with the boundaries checked by ArchUnit and a contract inventory test.
